name: TextArea
description: The TextArea component provides an accessible, fully-featured multiline text input field with support for labels, error states, and helper text.
usage: Accessible: Includes proper labeling, ARIA attributes, and error states
Error States: Displays error messages with appropriate styling
Focus States: Visual indication when the textarea is focused
Helper Text: Optional descriptive text below the textarea using `.type-caption`
Required Field Support: Visual indicator for required fields
Customizable: Styling can be customized via className props
Resizable: Users can resize the textarea to see more content at once
Sizes: 'xs' (smaller typography and padding, for dense UIs like sidebars) and 'md' (default); compact is the deprecated alias for 'xs'
design: Labels use `.type-label` (14px medium) for consistent form styling, or `.type-label-sm` at size xs.
Textarea uses `.type-body-sm` with reduced padding at size xs.
Helper text uses `.type-caption` which includes muted color semantically, or `.type-caption-compact` at size xs.
Error messages use `.type-body-sm` (14px) with error color override, or `.type-caption` at size xs.
One border colour per state: --color-border-subtle at rest, --color-error with an error, --color-border-emphasis disabled
examples:
// Disabled state
<TextArea
  id="autoGenerated"
  label="Auto-generated Content"
  disabled
  value={generatedContent}
  helperText="This content is auto-generated and cannot be edited"
/>
accessibility: Labels are properly associated with textareas using the for/id relationship
Error states are communicated to assistive technology via aria-invalid and aria-describedby
Helper text is linked to the textarea using aria-describedby
Required fields are marked both visually and with the required attribute
Focus shows on any focus (focus:ring-1 primary), as for every text field

props.name: id
props.description: The textarea's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Native: value for controlled, defaultValue for uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: The native change event (a native text field keeps the native signature)

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; shown unless touched is false or the field is disabled. Sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the textarea (not shown when error is displayed)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the container element

props.name: textareaClassName
props.description: Additional CSS class specifically for the textarea element

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show error at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left (false hides it)

props.name: required
props.description: Indicates if the field is required

props.name: disabled
props.description: Indicates if the field is disabled

props.name: size
props.description: xs: smaller type and padding (the scale's xs label type). Height is content-driven

props.name: compact
props.description: Deprecated: use size="xs". size wins when both are given

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, onKeyDown, onBlur, placeholder…) goes to the textarea; an aria-describedby is kept beside the helper or error id
